critical_code_review_comments: rewards_settlements._ensure_pay_link correctly skips cancel+recreate when link.url present and link.amount == d.amount — repeated PUTs with same amount reuse the link (verified in test_put_creates_link_and_reuses).

rewards_settlements._suggest uses salon_share_pct=0 fallback if unset — safe. Consider defaulting to 10 in the campaign settings model itself for clarity, but current UX default in RewardsCampaignCard handles it.

rewards_settlements.sa_settlement_reopen unsets paid_at/paid_method/paid_ref but does NOT reset pay_link. Semantically fine (link still valid at Razorpay). However if the amount changes after reopen it will be replaced correctly via _ensure_pay_link. LGTM.
_settlement_rows.pay_url falls back to '' when link missing/failed; UI gracefully hides paylink cell when empty.
SettlementIn.due_date regex ^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})?$ still accepts calendar-invalid dates (2026-02-31). Low priority since HTML date input picker guards UI.
Frontend PartnerGrid uses partner-trusted-{p.id} testid — verified sort-first behavior on landing. Good.
